video_title: Lonzo Ball Addresses Retirement Rumors: “I’m Not Retired” | Ball in the Family Ep. 35

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball clarifies he is not retired after major surgery
quotes.excerpt: I’m not retired, but I can play. Nobody wants to run that clip where I literally said I’m good enough to play.
quotes.quote: I’m not retired, but I can play. Nobody wants to run that clip where I literally said I’m good enough to play. I feel like anybody that’s been through a major surgery, you’re never going to get back to where you’re supposed to be, you know? For the most part, you always have to manage it, deal with it, and that’s what I’m doing. I’m not pain-free, but I can play.

text_blocks.text: Did you guys see Stephen Silas talk about GTA? About how he said the league is going to fall down.

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: He is being dead ass, too. He is not joking around. I think he is being serious.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball defends the WNBA's growth and visibility
quotes.excerpt: The WNBA is flourishing. Look at what these women are doing. Look at the money they’re making.
quotes.quote: The WNBA is flourishing. Look at what these women are doing. Look at the money they’re making, they’ve made over the last few years. Look at the visibility of their league. They got four or five signature athletes that are representing major brands. These women have brands for themselves, the business women for themselves outside of the games. So a lot of that stuff, the politics that they bring into sports nowadays, I understand the messaging behind what they’re trying to do, but a person like me who just strictly cares for the purity of the sport, I do not give a fuck about none of that. I care about flourishing and pushing the league forward and that’s what’s happening right now.
